name: sdlc-skills
description: One plugin for coding agents: sdlc takes a change from a story you agree to a reviewed pull request, by pair programming or on autopilot, and keeps a short AGENTS.md. An optional second, working-agreement, sets how the agent works with you.

plugins.name: sdlc
plugins.description: Extreme Programming with an agent: you decide what gets built, as a PRD that holds the north star, user stories with acceptance criteria you agree, spikes, bug tickets, chores, specs and decision records, then pair-program it with you steering, or build it on autopilot with failing tests first and a blind test challenger, through one fresh review to a pull request you merge, and keep a short AGENTS.md. At session start, a hook prints a routing list.

plugins.name: working-agreement
plugins.description: Optional house rules for how the agent works with you: keep it simple, look facts up instead of asking, one decision per question that yes accepts, and explanations that lead with what a thing means for you and a concrete case before the mechanism and its name. One hook adds them at session start.
